V0.1.0.0 Beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Orange Moon after this update is officially in beta! This update adds the final 10th level, with the final Punisher M3 boss. You'll also have a Punisher M1 machine to help you complete this level and finish the game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/23640178f6ba7dcc578fe37b5120ba6b60c6e611.png

Before compiling this update I have discovered a major bug - player cannot progress past the level 8 and would be caught in a loop playing level 8 over and over. This bug was there since level 9 added and is now fixed.

MRC Punisher M1
Obsolete version of MRC heavy war machine. Heavy armored and equipped with machine gun and grenades of older versions, it has to be navigated by technician, unlike its successor.

MRC Punisher M3
Heavily armored and armed biomechanical machine that guards MRC spaceports and compounds. Only one deployed on MRC main base on Orange Moon. Equipped with a minigun and rockets.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/d5801f970cc045f35f69015473376fc7b2b50d7c.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/fa04d247456088b937302eadb4b53c94fa438d14.png

The Steam version of a game now comes with DirectX redistributable.
If the latest DirectX runtime components are not installed, the game may fall back to a software-rendered canvas2d renderer and run with poor performance.
If you still experience issues after installing DirectX, especially crashes, poor performance or graphical glitches, try to update your graphics driver since many issues can arise from out-of-date drivers.

The list of new features and bug fixes below.

New
[olist]
 Level 10 - final level of Orange Moon;
 Usable Punisher M1 Machine to fight Punisher M3;
 Final boss - Punisher M3;
 Story continues on level 10.
[/olist]

Bug fixes and improvements
[olist]
 Fixed saving point z-order
 Increased Loader’s flamer damage to astronaut;
 Fixed - MRC trooper won't play death animation after first instance killed;
 Orb Tree idle animation is now playing;
 Major bug fixed - player wont stuck on level 8. After completing level 8 will spawn on level 9;
 The game window can now be resized if window mode enabled.
[/olist]

And don't forget to save once you boarded the machine and entered hangars!

Whats next
Achievements, story completed and more.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/385e90de56fa218c9dac9139f53dd4fb25333d1c.png

notes.content:
Made out of Orange Moon lifeforms, human and mechanical parts, this abomination lays toxic smoke bombs and spits acid. Upon approach it spawns highly flammable toxic clouds around itself as a protection from predators. It is slow and clumsy, obviously an experiment gone wrong.  Uses pair of augmented human hands to drag its huge body around.

Quantity on the moon - unknown.

Who is to blame for their existence - raiders, aliens or Moon Resources Corp.?

Moon abomination encountered on 7th level of Orange Moon - “Excavations”.

Moon Resources Corporation troops - MRC Trooper and MRC Punisher boss, to be deployed on Orange Moon.
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/10bab598bf9bcc90a2be772ae908b5040e30182d.png

Two new enemies are coming to Orange Moon - MRC trooper and MRC “Punisher” boss, both belong to Moon Resources Corp. faction. They will be encountered on the first introduction to Orange Moon and the last levels.

MRC TROOPER
These heavy armored and heavily augmented human soldiers used by MRC to protect corporation assets such as mines and archeological excavations. They are also used to deal with the raiders. Armed with tactical machine gun and grenade launcher. Grenades won't do much damage to these soldiers. Armor piercing bullets or 50mm prove to be the most effective way to deal with them.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/f5b16e54a88fb133f18e94f9c693aca45bf5d848.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/cfeb7d9699b0a9cad56fa51750af9e0020477fc8.png

MRC PUNISHER
Heavy armored and armed bio mechanical machine that guards MRC spaceports and compounds. Only one deployed on MRC main base on Orange Moon. Equipped with a minigun and a rocket launcher.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/e511fef5980b4234a9e0ad451a22271b039e6f64.png

Two new enemies - forgotten astronaut and raider are coming to Orange Moon
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/a409bb2be005e3ac0dbb3570c845dab7718ecfe9.png
Two new enemies - forgotten astronaut and raider are coming to Orange Moon in the next after controller support update. These are the first human (and not so human enemies) of Orange Moon.

RAIDER
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/d9db6e430c7ebd3a0ff41403ed3147ca110ff48f.png

These are a big problem for Moon Resources Corp. They raid anything they can, pillaging archaeological sites, destroying MRCorp equipment and killing prospectors. Heavily armored, they can be a challenge for unprepared astronaut. Machine guns that they use are not of the best quality and jam a lot though.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/3fe9e575e23f5e95ca206d04fdd06fd376666b4a.png

FORGOTTEN ASTRONAUT
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/8f6658fc949adf98b88761155796f60724e15521.png

Heavily augmented, human in the past, adopted to moon environment omnivorous zombie, wondering the landscapes of Orange Moon. It gathers grenades and landmines to hunt moon’s life to survive. It also collects junk and use it to hold the landmines and grenades in place on his back. Approaching too close may cause landmines to activate, resulting in explosion. Frontal assault is almost pointless as it's invulnerable to most damage, except for fire and explosives. Fastest way to kill it is to target the mines and grenades on its back.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23795648/75eb5c2c3933279c87b4475f0f02e334e29fa47a.png

notes.title: Orange Moon - most dangerous. Part 1.
notes.content:
Most dangerous creatures that inhabit Orange Moon.

Orange Moon, home to native life forms, raiders, remnants of alien civilization and harsh environments. Below are some most dangerous species of Orange Moon you will encounter in your journey.

Moon Piranha
 https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e040e1_4b3f8147583345f39e0be8867d5db4f2.png/v1/fill/w_980,h_550,al_c,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/e040e1_4b3f8147583345f39e0be8867d5db4f2.png 
Vulnerable to all damage types, especially fire damage. Pretty common for Orange Moon. First encounter with Piranha will be on lvl 4.

 Moon Piranha HR  


Recycler
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e040e1_79051ee86fde4fba9ce472478c8b81cc.png/v1/fill/w_980,h_552,al_c,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/e040e1_79051ee86fde4fba9ce472478c8b81cc.png
This is the first boss that you will encounter. Drops upgrades and ammo when killed. Recycler will appear on lvl 5.

 Recycler HR 


Loader
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e040e1_7eeca346999a4d73b59ae88d5b97a4d7.png/v1/fill/w_979,h_552,al_c,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/e040e1_7eeca346999a4d73b59ae88d5b97a4d7.png
First serious foe of Orange Moon that you'll encounter. Loader mini boss is available in Orange Moon v0.0.1.2, level 3.
High health - 200HP, awards 100 points. Drops fuel if killed with headshot. Usually holds terminal keys.

 Loader HR
